paragraphs: ProDIGIQ sells enterprise software for aerospace and defense operations. The homepage states that the software is designed, built and supported in the USA, and presents ATHENA as its ProDIGIQ AI offering.

The Flight Operations System, NAXOS, covers air operations assignment, aircrew scheduling and qualifications, and weighs crew availability, seniority, qualifications and currency when it builds schedules. The Advanced Qualification Program system, SIROS, automates aircrew training and evaluation with electronic forms, curriculum, scheduling and records tracking.
The homepage carries a testimonial from Paul Sichko, Assistant Director of MSP Operations at Minneapolis - St. Paul International Airport, about the ITHACA Notice of Violation system.
